thesis: The speaker recounts his unconventional career path from photography and bartending to endowment management, driven by a desire to apply organizational principles like employee ownership to the investment field. He explains that his initial interest in socially responsible investing led him to seek out Dean Takahashi at the Yale Investments Office, though he later realized that community economic development and traditional investing were distinct fields.
